summary: Verified iter 70: (1) Blog body text now renders in brand navy #2B3A4A (rgb(43,58,74)) on paragraphs, list items, and strong text — visually readable. (2) Admin B2B inventory returns and renders all 10 SKUs with pieces_per_carton (Bakhoor=32, Agarbatti Jar=16, Agarbatti packet=12), stock_pieces, stock_cartons, is_active. Adjust +100 pieces persists and reflects in list. (3) New Best-Time-to-Send endpoints: retailer endpoint returns default (Tue/Wed/Thu 10-13 IST) with default:true/sample_size:0 when no history; returns Tue 15-18 IST slot after 5 opens at Tue 10:00 UTC. Audience endpoint aggregates 9 opens correctly. Composer modal shows the blue best-time panel with 3 slot chips (first highlighted). 7/7 unit tests + 4/4 E2E tests pass. Regression: nudge open pixel returns image/gif 200. All 3 focus items verified GREEN.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_b2b_catalog backfill approach is idempotent and safe — good pattern for schema evolution on existing rows.
b2b_nudge_send_time.py uses IST (UTC+5:30) hardcoded — acceptable for India-only retailer base; consider a settings-driven TZ if scope expands.
